products.name: Pearl Hour
products.desc: A gold-tone curve carries a printed clock face, a line of pearl-tone beads and sculpted teardrop forms. The asymmetry keeps the eye moving; one open neckline is enough to give the piece its frame.

products.name: Lilac Reverie
products.desc: Clouded glass petals gather around dark crystal centres, with small zircon points catching the light. The clustered silhouette reads as a soft flower from a distance and reveals a harder, jewelled centre up close.

products.name: Serpentine Psalm
products.desc: Turquoise enamel is traced with oxblood and a fine gold-tone line, then finished with red glass. The long serpent curve frames the jaw and gives a plain shirt or dark tailored collar a sharper line.

products.name: Morpho Nocturne
products.desc: A layered blue-green resin wing sits inside gold-tone filigree, with dark centre stones and a faceted drop. Cobalt and green shift across the surface as the light moves.

products.name: Nocturne of the Deep
products.desc: A set of silver-tone forms drawn from a shell, a coral branch, a pearl-tone bead and a long filament. Wear the group across a lapel as one composition, or separate one form as a quieter mark.

products.name: Coral Reliquary
products.desc: Coral-tone glass drops are held in gold-tone filigree, with blue-green resin cabochons at the crown and zircon points above. The warm red-orange reads strongly against black and ecru.

products.name: Opaline Arch Cuff
products.desc: An open gold-tone cuff is inlaid with four blue-green resin panels and edged with zircon. The wide horizontal arc gives the wrist presence; keep rings restrained and let the cuff hold the line.

products.name: Two Doves
products.desc: Two silver-tone doves face a faceted yellow-glass drop, with zircon detailing across the wings. The rigid curve sits around the collarbone and keeps its shape against bare skin or a dark neckline.
